titulo: Private colleges around Australia offering last-minute discounts for diploma allegedly ‘misused by shonks’
cuerpo: Federal government to deregister graduate diploma of management in October over fears it was being used by ‘non-genuine’ students to remain in country Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Private colleges are offering discounts to rush students into a diploma the federal government is cancelling over concerns it is being “misused by shonks”. The government announced in early September it would deregister the graduate diploma of management (learning) which it suspected was being used by “non-genuine” students to remain in Australia. The course is taught by close to 450 institutions, has over 15,000 students studying currently and more than 40,000 students registered for future enrolment following completion of a different vocational course.
